g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.text: One 1.3k resistor per LED (the original used 330 ohm on 3.3 V): about 0.45 mA each on badge power, about 0.2 mA each on a fresh cell.

g.desc: One 1.3k resistor per LED (the original used 330 ohm on 3.3 V): about 0.45 mA each on badge power, about 0.2 mA each on a fresh cell.

g.text: D1, D2: white reverse-mount LEDs on the back, shining through the board where NorthSec's two 3 mm through-hole LEDs stood.

g.desc: D1, D2: white reverse-mount LEDs on the back, shining through the board where NorthSec's two 3 mm through-hole LEDs stood.

g.text: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected (as on the original), so no series diode is needed on the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).

g.desc: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected (as on the original), so no series diode is needed on the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.
